summary: Verified two follow-up fixes on top of iteration_10 baseline + light platform regression sweep (frontend only, external backend untouched). Both fixes PASS. Core roles (Customer, Provider, Receptionist, Admin) all login + render as expected. No regressions detected.

FIX-1_todayISO_local_date.evidence: Reorder POST /api/queue/reorder body captured: {"date":"2026-07-01", "ordered_ids":[...]}. Body date matches local date (built from Date.getFullYear/getMonth/getDate) — no toISOString().slice(0,10) UTC branch. Container is UTC so local==UTC today, but code path is verified from utils-app.js todayISO() (lines 66-73) using local Date components. Persistence check: after hard reload, queue order matches post-drag order — reorder persisted server-side.
FIX-1_todayISO_local_date.note: IST off-by-one edge case can only be reliably reproduced by simulating a browser TZ where UTC and IST cross midnight; code inspection confirms local-only construction, which mathematically eliminates the UTC drift. IST run in a real browser would send today's IST date at 00:30 IST as required.

FIX-2_whatsapp_invite_template.wa_preview_text: Hi TEST_WI_Jane, we've been sharing SlotNow with friends & family — skip the queue and book slots online. Try it: https://slotnow-web.preview.emergentagent.com/login
FIX-2_whatsapp_invite_template.evidence: wa-preview text contains ${window.location.origin}/login (dynamically resolved). WhatsAppModal.jsx buildTemplates.invite uses template literal with window.location.origin — no hardcoded string. Verified by decoding wa.me text query param — contains dynamic origin + /login. On this preview host origin happens to equal slotnow-web.preview.emergentagent.com, but the source of truth is now window.location.origin (would resolve differently on prod/other hosts).

critical_code_review_comments: utils-app.js todayISO() correctly uses local date components — good fix. Note: nextNDays() still uses toISOString().slice(0,10) for iso field (line 82). This could cause the same IST off-by-one bug if used for API calls in future work. Consider centralizing on todayISO()-style local construction across the file for consistency.
WhatsAppModal.jsx buildTemplates.invite uses (typeof window !== 'undefined' ? window.location.origin : '') — correctly SSR-safe. Good.
Reorder request path is /queue/reorder (verified via network capture) — matches iteration_10 contract.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Both fixes (todayISO local date + WhatsApp invite dynamic origin) are green in iteration_11. The full customer booking end-to-end, provider onboarding image upload, history-page contact actions, and customer Refer & Share were not re-executed since no code changes touch those flows in this iteration (iteration_10 remains the passing baseline for them). For a full E2E next time, use the shared login() helper pattern: role click -> phone -> Continue -> single OTP input placeholder="123456" -> Verify & Login -> wait for 'Skip' text button -> click. The Skip link on the PIN interstitial is a plain <button>Skip</button>, not test-id'd.
rca_of_the_issue: N/A — verification-only iteration. Both fixes root-caused correctly by main agent: (a) toISOString() returns UTC ISO which shifts to previous day for IST between 00:00-05:30 IST — replaced with local Date component construction. (b) Previously the invite template embedded a hardcoded preview host string; now interpolated from window.location.origin so it adapts to whatever host the app is served from.
